title: GC-MoE K3: A Green-Context Role Graph for Latent Mixture-of-Experts Decode
abstract: arXiv:2611.30542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kimi K3 combines a latent routed mixture of experts with full-width shared experts. A complete feed-forward evaluation must score and select experts, project tokens into the latent space, exchange tokens across expert-parallel ranks, compute the routed and shared branches, and normalize and project the routed sum before joining the branches. We present GC-MoE K3, a datacenter Blackwell implementation that schedules this entire evaluation as a CUDA Graph across two Green Contexts. Five base roles split input projection, routing, dispatch, expert computation, and finalization. Dispatch can fill the routed input ring while the compute partition evaluates shared experts. Finalize waits for the expert owners needed by each token and overlaps routed reduction and RMSNorm with loading the output projection weights. Conditional roles reuse the communication partition for routed computation and reduce split-$K$ projection partials. On GB200 at

translated_title: GC-MoE K3：面向潜在混合专家解码的绿色上下文角色图
translated_abstract: Kimi K3 将潜在路由的专家混合与全宽共享专家相结合。一次完整的前馈计算必须对专家进行评分与选择、将 token 投影到潜在空间、在专家并行秩之间交换 token、计算路由分支与共享分支，并在合并各分支之前对路由求和结果进行归一化与投影。我们提出 GC-MoE K3，这是一个数据中心级 Blackwell 实现，将整个前馈计算调度为跨越两个绿色上下文的单个 CUDA 图。五个基础角色分别承担输入投影、路由、分发、专家计算和收尾工作。当计算分区评估共享专家时，分发过程可同步填充路由输入环形缓冲区；收尾角色等待每个 token 所需的专家所有者，并将路由归约和 RMSNorm 与输出投影权重的加载重叠执行。条件角色复用通信分区来执行路由计算，并对 split-K 投影的部分结果进行归约。在 GB200 上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GC-MoE K3 将 Kimi K3 的潜在混合专家前馈解码全过程调度为跨越两个绿色上下文的单个 CUDA 图，通过五个基础角色实现路由、分发、共享专家计算与收尾工作的重叠执行，从而加速数据中心 Blackwell GPU 上的 MoE 推理。
en_tdlr: GC-MoE K3 schedules Kimi K3's entire latent mixture-of-experts feed-forward evaluation as a single CUDA Graph spanning two Green Contexts, using five base roles to overlap routing, dispatch, shared-expert computation, and finalization to accelerate MoE decoding on datacenter Blackwell GPUs.
